# `/non-employee-approvals` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /non-employee-approvals/v1

`listNonEmployeeApprovalsV1` — Get list of non-employee approval requests

This gets a list of non-employee approval requests. There are two contextual uses for this endpoint: 1. The user has the role context of `idn:nesr:read`, in which case they can list the approvals for any approver. 2. The user owns the requested approval.

- Scopes: idn:nelm:read
- Parameters:
  - `requested-for` (query) — The identity for whom the request was made. *me* indicates the current user.
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `count` (query) — default False — If *true* it will populate the *X-Total-Count* response header with the number of results that would be returned if *limit* and *offset* were ignored. Since requesting a total count can have a…
  - `filters` (query) — fields: approvalStatus: eq — e.g. `approvalStatus eq "Pending"`
  - `sorters` (query) — fields: created, modified — e.g. `created`
- Returns 200: array of nonemployeeapprovalitem

### GET /non-employee-approvals/v1/{id}

`getNonEmployeeApprovalV1` — Get a non-employee approval item detail

Gets a non-employee approval item detail. There are two contextual uses for this endpoint: 1. The user has the role context of `idn:nesr:read`, in which case they can get any approval. 2. The user owns the requested approval.

- Scopes: idn:nelm:read
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — Non-Employee approval item id (UUID)
  - `include-detail` (query) — The object nonEmployeeRequest will not be included detail when set to false. *Default value is true*
- Returns 200: nonemployeeapprovalitemdetail

### POST /non-employee-approvals/v1/{id}/approve

`approveNonEmployeeRequestV1` — Approve a non-employee request

Approves a non-employee approval request and notifies the next approver. The current user must be the requested approver.

- Scopes: idn:nelm:manage
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — Non-Employee approval item id (UUID)
- Body (application/json): nonemployeeapprovaldecision
- Returns 200: nonemployeeapprovalitem

### POST /non-employee-approvals/v1/{id}/reject

`rejectNonEmployeeRequestV1` — Reject a non-employee request

This endpoint will reject an approval item request and notify user. The current user must be the requested approver.

- Scopes: idn:nelm:manage
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — Non-Employee approval item id (UUID)
- Body (application/json): nonemployeerejectapprovaldecision
- Returns 200: nonemployeeapprovalitem

### GET /non-employee-approvals/v1/summary/{requested-for}

`getNonEmployeeApprovalSummaryV1` — Get summary of non-employee approval requests

This request will retrieve a summary of non-employee approval requests. There are two contextual uses for the `requested-for` path parameter: 1. The user has the role context of `idn:nesr:read`, in which case he or she may request a summary of all non-employee approval requests assigned to a particular approver by passing in that approver's id. 2. The current user is an approver, in which case "me" should be provided as the `requested-for` value. This will provide the approver with a summary…

- Scopes: idn:nelm:read
- Parameters:
  - `requested-for` (path, required) — The identity (UUID) of the approver for whom for whom the summary is being retrieved. Use "me" instead to indicate the current user.
- Returns 200: nonemployeeapprovalsummary
